decisions.reason: The relocation of the panel power-button connector to the main board and its connection to J_PWR_SIG pin 4 are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY Event.
The added panel power-button connector is on the main board and does not change any sensor-board input or output connector.
The new connector only taps the existing PWRON signal at J_PWR_SIG pin 4; it does not alter the interboard connector type, pinout, or matching requirements.
The panel power-button connector does not change the charge-status indicator, CHGLED connector, or associated resistor and population requirements.
The new connector taps the dedicated PWRON line and does not introduce or change an ESP32 GPIO assignment.

The source does not change the existing GPIO-mapped panel inputs, reset wiring, touch inputs, or connector-based mounting policy; the dedicated power-button behavior is independently represented by REQ_PANEL_POWER_CONTROL.
Adding a connector that taps PWRON does not change the main-board power-source OR-ing topology, sources, or source-selection behavior.
The panel power-button connector does not change the monitored rails, monitor IC, channel count, or current-monitor placement.
The PWRON button connection does not affect addressable-LED supply voltage, power switching, or data-level shifting.
The source adds a control-signal tap and does not change the board-chain order, power connectors, distributed rails, or forwarding behavior.
The new PWRON connector does not change standalone USB activation, the LDO selection or capacity, or the devices powered in standalone mode.
The source does not modify the main board's local decoupling requirement.
